Commentary.Commentary: So that's it from us for the night. Bangladesh have stunned one and all by booking a place in the final with India. They have not played their best cricket but are still here. Tonight, they were spectacular but they need to be more than that when they take on the number 2 ODI team on Friday. That match will take place in Dubai on September 28, 2018 at 1530 local (1130 GMT). Hopefully, it is a cracker. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

MUSHFIQUR RAHIM IS NAMED THE MAN OF THE MATCH. The wicket-keeper batsman states that Bangladesh were prepared to lose a couple of early wickets against a quality bowling attack like Pakistan's but he and Mithun believed that once the new-ball passage was through, they can get runs in the middle overs. Credits his constant practice for playing strokes consistently and the almighty for helping him keep calm in tough situations.

Victorious Bangladesh captain, Mashrafe Mortaza, says that tonight they changed the bowling line-up a bit. Normally, he starts but he let Mustafizur take the new ball. Does not quite specify the reason but credits the entire bowling and fielding units. Hopes that his team produces this same performance on Friday in the final. On his flying catch to dismiss Malik, the modest skipper puts it down to luck and states that had he dropped that, Malik would have taken Pakistan home. On their big match against India, Mashrafe states that India are the number 1 team in the world while his own team would be without Tamim or Shakib. But still, they need to give their best and try and win the trophy.

Pakistan skipper, Sarfraz Ahmed, admits that he is not feeling happy at all. But says that if you do not play well, then you cannot win and takes the blame on himself for not leading from the front. Stressing on the weak aspects, he first points out to fielding, then bowling in the middle overs, not batting well consistently and eventually, spin bowling. On Fakhar Zaman's poor form, he agrees that the opener has been giving them good starts post the Champions Trophy while Shadab and Hasan have been doing well in the middle overs but their batting collapses in this tournament have hurt them the most. Is proud of the newbie Shaheen Afridi and reckons that he is a good prospect.

Not too long ago, Bangladesh fans were cursing their players after their big loss to India. But they have overcome all those comments and have stormed into the final. The bowling stood up once again, with the young Mustafizur falling just one short of a fifer. But the most underestimated bowlers of the evening - Mehidy Hasan, Mahmudullah and Soumya Sarkar - well, they were the main ones responsible for keeping the lid on the proceedings. Their collective figures were 25-1-85-4 with 82 dot balls. Excellent team performance. Please stay tuned for the presentation to see who gets the Man Of The Match award.

Credit has to be given to Pakistan though. They looked down and out at 94/5 but Imam and Asif staged another recovery. They nearly got the batting side on a path which could have led to victory. However, with 75 needed from 65 balls, Mehidy and Mahmudullah struck in successive overs to send both the set batsmen back and that sealed the chase.

Having kept Bangladesh to 239, the momentum was firmly with Pakistan. However, just like Bangladesh, they were reduced to 3 down in no time. Shoaib Malik and Imam-ul-Haq then tried to revive the innings but a Mashrafe special sent Malik back in the hut.

Comfortable win for Bangladesh. Their fourth in a row in ODIs over Pakistan. Who would have thought that? Right from the start of the tournament, the predictions have been an India-Pakistan final. Now, that script has changed.

A FORWARD DEFENSE to end the game. Full and outside off, Afridi pushes it towards cover. The non-striker wants a single and the throw comes in at his end but misses the stumps. Does not matter. BANGLADESH WIN BY 37 RUNS AND ARE IN THE FINAL!!!

Full and outside off, Khan hits this down the ground. Initially, he does not run, because he thinks mid off will stop it. But then, the ball goes past the fielder. Full and outside off, hit hard to mid off for a quick single. Junaid starts to run but then forgets that he has to drag his bat in. Mashrafe Mortaza's throw misses the stumps at the bowler's end. Direct hit could have been interesting.
Full and outside off, blasted through the covers for a single.
Backs away, Rubel bowls a pinpoint yorker on middle, Shaheen swings hard again but gets a bottom edge back to the bowler.

SIX! HUMONGOUS! This kid can bat. A length ball outside off, Afridi swings it massively over mid-wicket! One of my colleagues, Mr. Polite, reckons that reminded him of the sixes Sourav Ganguly used to hit. Good memory.

EDGED, PUT DOWN! Mustafizur is robbed of a fifer. But Liton cannot be blamed for this. A length ball, outside off, moving away, Afridi pushes at it and gets a healthy outside edge. Das dives full length to his left but the ball hits the webbing of his left glove and pops out.
Full and outside off, Khan pushes at it and gets a thick outside edge behind point. A single taken.

HUGE APPEAL FOR CAUGHT BEHIND! IS THE MATCH OVER? Nope. A length ball around off, angling away, Junaid looks to defend but is beaten. Liton Das collects and immediately starts jumping in an appeal but the umpire is unmoved. Snickometer detects nothing.
A length ball outside off, Junaid swings but misses.
The yorker, swinging in, around leg, Afridi somehow gets his bat to sneak the ball towards square leg. Mustafizur starts to appeal but then bails out. A single taken.
Junaid Khan is the last man in to complete the final rites.

OUT! That is a cracking shot but the boundary is very large and the man pouches it in the deep. Pakistan are 9 down. A short ball, around middle, Nawaz gets hold of it and latches onto the pull. The sound made of the bat connecting with the ball is superb but as we have seen in this tournament, the boundaries are way too large. Nawaz gets the height but not the distance. Substitute Nazmul Hossain Shanto settles under it calmly.
Outside off, Nawaz swings hard but gets a thick inside edge which just goes past the stumps. A quick single taken.
Full and around off, Afridi works it through mid-wicket for a run.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Outside off, Nawaz slashes but misses.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
WIDE. A bouncer on middle, Nawaz ducks.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Rubel Hossain is back on. 5-0-22-1 so far.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.

OUT! In the air, in the air, in the air and Bangladesh get one step closer to the final! A short ball on middle, Hasan backs away once again and attempts the pull. But he is done in by the cutter. He is a master of these. All he gets is a top edge because he is months early into the shot. Mashrafe Mortaza runs to his left from mid on and takes it easily.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Outside off, played towards point. Hasan wants a single but is sent back.
FOUR! HAMMERED! A length ball outside off, Hasan backs away and slaps it over mid off for a boundary! 59 needed from 40 balls now.
Walks across his stumps, looks to flick but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads. The ball goes to fine leg and the batsmen take a single.
Mustafizur Rahman is back on. 6-1-33-2 so far.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
The arm ball, skids on, Hasan looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. Mahmudullah appeals but the umpire spots the piece of wood.
WIDE. Down the leg side, Hasan misses his flick.
Another dot. The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Outside off, punched back to the bowler.
The batsman failed to make contact and was hit low on the pads. They pick up a single. Leg bye given by the umpire.
Another drive through the covers, this time it is in the gap and a run is taken. Excellent spell from Mehidy - 10-1-28-2. Super stuff.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Oohhh... has a wild slog at this. The ball darts in and goes off the inner half towards square leg. A run taken.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Full and outside off, blocked towards cover.

Full and outside off, Hasan is squared up as he looks to defend. The ball runs off the outside edge towards third man and a couple if taken. 4 runs and a wicket from that over, Mahmudullah's figures read 9-0-35-1.
Hasan Ali trudges in at number 9, replacing Imam.

OUT! Another stumping and this time it is Imam! This should be game over for Pakistan now. Beautiful bowling by Mahmudullah who is pumped up. He tosses this one outside off and Imam immediately jumps out, aiming to go inside out. However, he is done in by the flight and misses his shot. But Liton doesn't. He is as cool as a cucumber and takes off the bails in a flash. Imam tries to get back but he is miles out of the crease. Liton throws the ball up in the air in celebration. The batting side needs 73 from 55 balls with 3 wickets in hand.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. Spirited effort by the fielder to save runs for his team.
Comes down the track and drives it towards cover.
Helps it through square leg for a quick run.
Full and outside off, driven towards cover for a single.
Final Powerplay of the Super Four. 5 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle. 75 needed from 60 balls with 4 wickets in hand. Mahmudullah is back on. 8-0-31-0 so far.
Full and outside off, watchfully blocked out.
The arm ball, on middle and leg, pushed back to the bowler.
Outside off, pushed towards short extra cover.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.

OUT! Stumped! Very good keeping. Makes up for his dropped catch by this sharp take. Off spinner lands on middle. It spins a tad as Ali looks to drive this one coming forward. Misses it completely, Liton collects the ball and takes off the bails in a flash. They check it up for confirmation and Ali is well short. The 71-run stand is finally broken. The end is neigh for Pakistan.
Stumped or bowled? Liton Das is not showing his confidence but Asif is walking... referred upstairs.
That kept low. Full and in line of the stumps, Ali does well to get bat to ball.
Direct hit but Ali is well in. Good backing up for the fielding side. Full and on off, Ali hits it towards mid on and sets off for the run.
Short again outside off. This time Imam is in control as he pulls it through mid-wicket for one.
Played through mid-wicket by Ali. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Short ball outside off, Imam pulls but does not get the timing right. It falls wide of the man at mid-wicket. They come back for the second run.
Length ball in line of the stumps. Imam looks to turn his bat to the on side but gets a soft leading edge towards the bowler.

Ali defends it from within the crease. 81 more needed from the last 12 overs.
Quicker one outside off. Asif goes to cut it but cannot put bat to ball.

Asif flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Comes down plays with the turn and hits it to the leg side to give his partner the strike.
Neatly done. The fielder was in the deep and Imam played it with soft hands towards mid-wicket. Calls for two and gets there in the end.
Mehidy Hasan to roll his arm.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
No damage done. Good ball. Full and outside off, Imam looks to drive it with force but cannot time it well. Goes straight to the man at mid off.

An explanation of why that was a no ball. Before the ball was bowled, third man, fine leg, cover, mid on and mid-wicket were inside the circle. But just at the last moment, Mortaza sent third man back. As per the rules, you need to have 5 players inside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. FREE HIT COMING UP NOW.
No ball! There were just 4 fielders inside the ring. Slower ball outside off, touched with soft hands towards point. A quick single results. Free Hit up next!
Imam's go-to shot in the last couple of overs. Waits for the ball and runs it down to third man to get off strike.

Another similar shot. Waits for the ball and runs this down towards third man for a single.

The skipper, Mashrafe Mortaza comes back for another spell.
Closes the bat face early and hits it past the bowler for a run.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Outside off, hit to the off side.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Angles this away from Ali who plays it to point.

Ali tries to guide it but gets a fine edge to it. Das was not ready for it and just sticks his right hand out hoping for the ball to stick. It doesn't and Ali gets a life.
Mustafizur Rahman comes back for another burst.
Imam drives this through the covers.

Imam rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.

Asif Ali too can swing his bat and this partnership will decide the fate. For Bangladesh they know it is just the matter of one wicket. Will Mashrafe get on his strike bowlers or just see this phase off?
Finds the gap and ends the over with a single. Goes back and punches it through covers.

Gets forward and drives this through covers for one.

Gets low and sweeps this through square leg for another run.
Comes ahead and bunts this down.

A touch short, punched down to long on for a run.
Punches this off the back foot for a run.

Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a run.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full on middle, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
Around middle and off, watchfully defended.

Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Driven through mid off by the batsman.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! A short ball, Asif pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On middle, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.

Similar ball, blocked towards the bowler.

Landed outside off, played towards point.

OUT! Caught down the leg side! Pakistan have now lost half their side. And what delight for Bangladesh - their part-timer has taken a wicket. A short ball, down the leg side, Shadab cannot control his instincts to pull. He goes for the shot but is cramped for room. The ball takes the glove and goes to the keeper who straightaway runs forward in celebration. Snickometer educates us that it is not glove, but a top edge. 146 more needed from 149 balls. MAIDEN ODI WICKET FOR SARKAR AS WELL.

On middle and leg, flicked through square leg for a single.

The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.

'SHOMU! SHOMU! SHOMU!' shouts Liton Das. There was a run out chance on offer. Outside off, Shadab drove it towards cover and set off for a single. OUT! Pick that out! What a screamer. And guess what? Shoaib Malik is out of here. Fuller ball on the legs of Malik. It stops and makes Malik flick earlier that he should have. The ball flies towards short mid-wicket where Mortaza dives full length to his left and grasps it with both hands. What a catch. We have already seen some good catches in this innings and we can add another one to this list. Bangladesh now have the upper hand as Pakistan need 155 more runs to win. Comes from round the wicket and lands it on a good length on middle and leg. Imam steps forward and blocks it to the off side.
Time for the fielding restrictions to get lifted a touch. Powerplay 2 is upon us, with 4 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle, till the 40th over.

The batsman defends it from within the crease. POWERPLAY 1 IS DONE. Pakistan are at a slightly better stage than Bangladesh. But this is that time when their opposition was recovering in a massive way.
Full and outside off, pushed towards point for a single.
Comes forward and works it wide of mid-wicket for a single.
Full again, driven sweetly but straight to cover.
Outside off, Imam looks to drive it through the off side but the ball goes off the inner half towards short mid-wicket.
Full and around leg, defended back to the bowler.
Spin once more. Mehidy Hasan to bowl the final over of Powerplay 1.
Full again, watchfully blocked out.
Full and around off, watchfully blocked out.
Stump-to-stump, doesn't give any width, so disciplined is the skipper. Malik is forced to respect and defend.
Nicely played. The ball is angling into the southpaw but Imam plays it down late, past that wide first slip fielder, towards third man. A run taken.
Full and just around off, watchfully defended on the walk towards mid on.
Full and down the leg side, flicked towards fine leg for a single.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full and outside off, Shoaib times his square drive crisply again but it is straight to the fielder. There is a direct hit at the bowler's end but Imam is in while there is no chance of an overthrow.

FOUR! Great shot again! After going for a boundary on the previous ball, the Fizz drops it a touch short. Malik is more than happy to see that length. He gets on top of the bounce with a gentle hop and punches it through the covers. That was more of a forehand winner in Tennis. Consecutive boundaries. 207 more needed from 254 balls. Malik moves to 12 from 15 balls.

FOUR! MAGNIFICENT! Great balance. And the timing is exquisite was well. Full and outside off, Malik comes forward, meets the ball on the half volley and drives it with the full face of the bat. Great elbow position too. The ball goes past the bowler and mid off. No chance for either. The stand moves to 11 from 24 balls.
Good length, just short of full, the line is just around off and Shoaib comes forward to defend.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Full and outside off, this time Imam meets it with a perfect off drive.

THAT STAYED LOW! This will now play in the minds of the batsmen. Mashrafe lands this somewhere around the good length, outside off and Imam hops back to defend. But then, the ball scoots low and the batsman is lucky that the bat comes down in time to meet the ball.
Similar shot, but this time it is in the gap. A single behind point.
Around off, pushed to the off side.
Down the leg side, Malik helps it through the leg side for a couple.

LBW shout, but not out. Mashrafe does not review. Imam walks across his sticks and the Bangladesh captain bowls it straight. The angle perhaps is taking the ball down the leg side as Mortaza is bowling from around the wicket. Imam misses his flick and is hit on the pads. There is an LBW appeal but it dies down pretty quickly. Hawk Eye shows it to be MISSING LEG. Meanwhile, a leg bye has been stolen. PAKISTAN FINALLY GET THEIR SCOREBOARD MOVING AFTER 12 DOTS ON THE TROT.
The batsman defends it from within the crease. CONSECUTIVE MAIDENS FOR BANGLADESH!!!
A lovely shot, but for nothing. Half volley outside off, Malik leans and drives it but straight to short extra cover.
Around off, SM gets across a touch and pushes it towards mid on.
Full and straight, watchfully defended.

Through him! Jaffa from Mustafizur. He lands it on a length outside off and Shoaib looks to defend from his crease. But at the last moment, the ball nips back in and cuts him into two! Goes right between bat and pad.
Full and around off, Malik is watchful and blocks it towards cover.
A MAIDEN FOR MASH! The captain has started well in this do-or-die game. Full and just around off, driven straight to mid off.
A bit of width outside off, pretty much full, Imam flashes hard but does not move his feet. The ball misses the outside edge by a whisker. Rahim appeals for the catch, but in vain.
A short ball outside off, played straight to point.
Full and straight, watchfully defended.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
Full and around middle, watchfully defended.
Skipper time. Mashrafe Mortaza to bowl now.
The batsman has nudged the ball fine down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
WIDE. Down the leg side, flick shot missed.

RUN OUT, RUN OUT, RUN OUT, BUT MISSED! Oh dear... Mahmudullah is the fielder. Pakistan would have been 4 down in the 4th over. A length ball outside off, Malik pushes this wide of mid off and keeps on running. But Imam is in no mood to respond. He is busy watching Mahmudullah run across to his left. All of a sudden, both batsmen are close to shaking hands with one another and Rahim screams to his brother-in-law to throw the ball but Mahmudullah takes his eyes off the ball at a crucial moment and fumbles. The ball rolls behind and Imam now runs across to the other end. What a lucky break.
Outside off, on a length, played towards point.
Shoaib Malik walks in at number 5, replacing his skipper.

OUT! Edged and a fantastic catch has been taken! This game is alive and kicking. If Bangladesh were 12/3, Pakistan are 18/3. Will we see a revival as we saw in the first innings or are Bangladesh smelling victory already? Let us not talk about the future for now. Let us be in the present. This moment belongs to that man - who scored a magnificent 99 with the bat, was tired but still helped Bangladesh recover. This wicket belongs to him. Full and outside off, angling away, Sarfraz chases it away from his body and does not bother to move his feet much. A poor shot and he pays the price. The edge flies behind but so does Mushfiqur Rahim. He goes to his right and takes it brilliantly. The Pakistan captain has come and now the Pakistan captain has gone. Is the Asia Cup gone too?
FOUR! Wrong line. Down the leg side, Sarfraz tickles it fine, towards the fence behind. There seems to be a fielder but he is very square.
On middle and leg, flicked through square leg for a single.
Around off, Sarfraz looks to defend from the crease but suddenly the ball shoots up and hits the splice of the bat. Lands safely on the leg side.
Full and on the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.

Excellent fielding! They are on fire in the field and have their tails up. Full and outside off, Imam drives it through the covers and the ball races away but Liton Das at short extra dives full length to his left to stop that. Gets a bad bounce but he manages to collect, get up and then fire a throw to the keeper.
Quicker one, just outside off, watchfully defended towards cover.
Outside off, eased through cover-point for a quick single.
Full and around off, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
Around off and outside, watchfully defended. 8 runs and a wicket from that Fizz over.
A length ball on middle and leg, tucked through square leg for a couple. Both the batsmen are off the mark now.
Full again, flicked behind square on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! LOVELY! The captain is off the mark in grand fashion. A bit of a half volley, outside off, Sarfraz comes forward and drives it through the covers. No stopping that.
WIDE. Plenty of swing for the Fizz. He lands this on a length but swings it down the leg side. Sarfraz looks to flick but misses. Good keeping by Rahim diving to his left.
The captain, Sarfraz Ahmed, walks in at number 4, replacing Babar.

OUT! LBW! Second wicket down for Pakistan and the Bangladesh fans are on fire!!! Terrific bowling. Mustafizur lands this on a length, around the line of the stumps, one would suppose. Babar is back in his crease to try and defend that but the ball skids off the surface and pings him on the back pad. Mustafizur, Mushfiqur and perhaps the whole of Bangladesh appeal. The umpire thinks for a while and then raises his finger! Babar walks over to Imam, has a bit of a chat but then, is on his way. No review taken. Hawk Eye shows that to be pitching in line and going on to clip the off stump. Umpire's call would have been the verdict if the review had been taken. Boy oh boy, the Men In Green are on top. Which one? You definitely know...
A length ball outside off, Azam looks to cut but gets a bottom edge to the off side.
Mustafizur Rahman to bowl with the second new ball.
Azam eases this down to long on and takes a run. Ends a successful over for Bangladesh.
Babar Azam is the new man in.

OUT! In the air... taken! What a catch! That was travelling and Rubel has plucked that out of thin air. Take a bow! Bangladesh are up and running as they have got rid of the dangerous Zaman in the first over itself. Once again he falls prey to a spinner. He uses his feet and gets to the pitch of the ball. Hits it hard but uppishly towards mid on. He must have thought boundary as soon as he hit it, but it wasn't to be. Hossain there, times his leap to perfection and hangs onto it. Falls onto the ground after taking it. Fakhar Zaman walks back in disbelief and once again he does not trouble the scorers a lot.
The arm ball on middle, Imam tries to defend but the ball goes off the inner half towards square leg for a run. He too is off the mark.
The pitch just might have quickened up under lights as once again it easily comes onto the bat. FZ punches it down to long off and Pakistan are off the mark.
Slower through the air this time, once again it skids on, good signs for the batsman. Zaman lunges and keeps it out.
Starts off with a flatter delivery on off, it skids through after pitching. Zaman cuts it to point.

We are back for the chase! The openers, Fakhar Zaman and Imam-ul-Haq make their way out to the middle. The former will be on strike and he will be facing a spinner first up. Mehidy Hasan has the first new ball in his hand. Here we go...
